title: Hygiene Entry: Gowning for the Production Area

steps.label: Handwash tap
steps.instruction: Wash your hands at the sink for at least 20 seconds.
steps.hazard: Hands carry the most contamination into production.
steps.wrongHint: Wash hands first, before touching any clean-side item.

steps.label: Sanitiser
steps.instruction: Sanitise your hands from the wall dispenser and let them dry.
steps.hazard: Wet hands transfer contamination to the coat.

steps.label: Clean coat
steps.instruction: Take a clean coat from the rail and put it on.
steps.hazard: Street clothing sheds fibres and particles.
steps.wrongHint: Put the coat on after hand hygiene, before footwear.

steps.label: Site boots
steps.instruction: Sit on the bench and change into site boots, swinging your legs over the line.
steps.hazard: Dirty-side shoes must never touch the clean-side floor.
steps.wrongHint: Change footwear after the coat, and before gloves.

steps.label: Glove dispenser
steps.instruction: Put on a fresh pair of gloves. This is the last garment.
steps.hazard: Gloves put on early get contaminated while gowning.
steps.wrongHint: Gloves go on last, once everything else is fitted.

steps.label: Interlock button
steps.instruction: Press the interlock button to enter the production area.
steps.hazard: Opening both doors at once breaks the air-pressure barrier.
steps.wrongHint: Only press the interlock once fully gowned.
